CRUD page ​

Example data, control text, messages and source comments may be in Chinese. Viewer controls and API headings use English. Untranslated API descriptions are marked.

AsamCrudPage combines a search form, a paginated results table, create and edit forms, and read-only details. Create its controller with useAsamCrudController from @asam-ui/pro. The application supplies the data services, permissions, and operation IDs.

When to use it ​

Use this page when users need to query, view, create, edit, and delete records in one place. The standard presentation puts the search form and table in separate cards. A valid search or reset starts at page one. Refresh and a successful save keep the current page while it remains valid.

The default details entry opens a right-side drawer from the name or first visible business column. Set detailEntry to choose the entry column or disable it. detailOnRowDblclick can independently enable double-click, and interactive controls do not trigger it. Use detailDisplay="dialog" for a dialog or the detail slot to supply your own display.

Set size for inputs and buttons and tableSize for row density. The standard table's large, default, small, and mini sizes use 60, 50, 42, and 36 px rows.

Examples ​

The examples and source viewer are included on this page. The standalone demo uses synthetic data.

<template>
	<AsamCrudPage
		v-model:border="showBorder"
		:controller="controller"
		:table-size="tableSize"
		:size="size"
		title="项目管理"
		description=""
		create-label="新建项目"
		edit-label="编辑项目"
		detail-label="项目详情"
		:action-column-width="homePreview ? 156 : 228"
		:action-button-type="showActionColors ? 'primary' : undefined"
		:save-button-type="showActionColors ? 'primary' : undefined"
		:cancel-button-type="showActionColors ? 'secondary' : undefined"
		:row-actions="showActionColors ? rowActions : undefined"
		:show-heading="tableOnly ? false : undefined"
		:page-padding="tableOnly ? 0 : undefined"
	>
		<template v-if="tableOnly" #query></template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { h, onBeforeUnmount, shallowRef } from 'vue';
import { AsamMessageBox, AsamTag, createAsamDataRuntime } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamControlSize, AsamTableSize } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { AsamCrudPage, useAsamCrudController } from '@asam-ui/pro/templates/crud';
import {
	createAsamWriteCoordinator,
	createAsamTableOperationCoordinator
} from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import type { AsamListAction } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import {
	createProjectMock,
	initialProjectQuery,
	projectEditorConfig,
	projectQueryCodec,
	projectQueryFields
} from './project/ProjectMock.js';
import type { ProjectQuery } from './project/ProjectMock.js';
import type { RichEdit, RichRow } from './project/RichFields.js';

defineOptions({ name: 'SharedCrudExample' });
const props = defineProps<{
	tableSize?: AsamTableSize;
	size?: AsamControlSize;
	homePreview?: boolean;
	tableOnly?: boolean;
	showActionColors?: boolean;
}>();
const showBorder = shallowRef(false);
const rowActionMessage = shallowRef('可用行内的「查看编号」核对项目。');
const rowActions: readonly AsamListAction<RichRow>[] = [
	{
		id: 'show-reference',
		label: '查看编号',
		button: { type: 'secondary', plain: true },
		scope: 'independent',
		run: async ({ row }) => {
			if (row) rowActionMessage.value = `${row.name}：${row.reference}`;
		}
	}
];
const mock = createProjectMock();
const runtime = createAsamDataRuntime();
let sequence = 0;
const confirm = (message: string) =>
	AsamMessageBox.confirm(message, '请确认').then(
		() => true,
		() => false
	);
const tone = (status: string) =>
	status === '进行中'
		? 'primary'
		: status === '已完成'
			? 'success'
			: status === '待启动'
				? 'warning'
				: 'info';
const controller = useAsamCrudController<RichRow, ProjectQuery, RichEdit, string | number>({
	runtime,
	writes: createAsamWriteCoordinator(),
	operations: createAsamTableOperationCoordinator(),
	rowKey: (row: RichRow) => row.id,
	isKey: (key: unknown): key is string | number =>
		typeof key === 'string' || (typeof key === 'number' && Number.isFinite(key)),
	dataset: 'website-projects',
	initial: { ...initialProjectQuery },
	queryFields: projectQueryFields,
	queryCodec: projectQueryCodec,
	...projectEditorConfig,
	services: mock.services,
	detail: { mode: 'load', load: mock.detail },
	columns: [
		{ key: 'name', label: '项目名称', width: props.homePreview ? 180 : 240, required: true },
		...(!props.tableOnly
			? [
					{
						key: 'reference' as const,
						label: '项目编号',
						width: props.homePreview ? 140 : 150,
						flex: false
					}
				]
			: []),
		{ key: 'owner', label: '负责人', width: props.homePreview ? 84 : 96, flex: false },
		{
			key: 'status',
			label: '状态',
			width: props.homePreview ? 96 : 110,
			flex: false,
			render: (row: RichRow) =>
				h(AsamTag, { type: tone(row.status), effect: 'light' }, () => row.status)
		},
		{ key: 'dueDate', label: '截止日期', width: props.homePreview ? 96 : 126, flex: false }
	],
	preferences: {
		scope: {
			application: 'docs',
			principal: 'visitor',
			table: 'website-projects',
			version: '2'
		},
		adapter: { load: async () => null, save: async () => {}, reset: async () => {} }
	},
	allowed: () => true,
	allowedRemove: () => true,
	confirmDiscard: () => confirm('放弃未保存内容？'),
	confirmRemove: () => confirm('删除所选项目？'),
	operationId: (action) => `website-${action}-${++sequence}`
});
onBeforeUnmount(() => {
	controller.dispose();
	runtime.invalidate();
});
</script>
ts
import type { AsamCrudCodec, AsamCrudServices } from '@asam-ui/pro/templates/crud';
import type { AsamFieldDefinition } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import { defineAsamOptions } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamOption } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { richCodec, richEquals, richFields } from './RichFields.js';
import type { RichEdit, RichRow } from './RichFields.js';

export interface ProjectQuery {
	name: string;
	owner: string | null;
	status: string | null;
	reference: string;
	dueDate: string | null;
	priority: string | null;
}
export const initialProjectQuery: ProjectQuery = {
	name: '',
	owner: null,
	status: null,
	reference: '',
	dueDate: null,
	priority: null
};
export const owners = ['陈晨', '林悦', '张远', '许宁', '周可', '沈知'];
export const statuses = ['进行中', '待启动', '已完成', '已暂停'];
const names = [
	'华东供应链协同平台',
	'园区设备巡检',
	'研发知识库升级',
	'客户服务工作台',
	'渠道结算自动化',
	'华南仓储可视化',
	'数据治理与指标口径统一',
	'生产计划排程',
	'质量追溯系统',
	'移动审批助手',
	'合同归档与检索',
	'团队协作空间'
];
const source = (values: readonly string[]) =>
	defineAsamOptions().static({ options: values.map((value) => ({ value, label: value })) });
const choice = (key: string, label: string, values: readonly string[]): AsamFieldDefinition => ({
	key,
	label,
	kind: 'single',
	source: source(values),
	adaptInput: (value) => {
		if (value === '' || value === null || value === undefined) return null;
		if (
			typeof value === 'string' ||
			typeof value === 'boolean' ||
			(typeof value === 'number' && Number.isFinite(value))
		)
			return value;
		throw new TypeError('选择值必须是合法标量或空值');
	},
	query: (value) => value ?? '',
	modes: { query: { componentProps: { placeholder: '全部', clearable: true } } }
});
export const projectQueryFields: readonly AsamFieldDefinition[] = [
	{
		key: 'name',
		label: '项目名称',
		kind: 'text',
		modes: { query: { componentProps: { placeholder: '输入项目名称', clearable: true } } }
	},
	choice('owner', '负责人', owners),
	choice('status', '项目状态', statuses),
	{
		key: 'reference',
		label: '项目编号',
		kind: 'text',
		modes: { query: { componentProps: { placeholder: '如 PRJ-2026-001', clearable: true } } }
	},
	{
		...richFields.find((field) => field.key === 'dueDate')!,
		modes: {
			query: {
				componentProps: {
					valueFormat: 'YYYY-MM-DD',
					placeholder: '选择日期',
					clearable: true
				}
			}
		}
	},
	choice('priority', '优先级', ['高', '中', '低'])
];
export const projectQueryCodec: AsamCrudCodec<ProjectQuery> = {
	encode: (model) => ({
		...model,
		owner: model.owner || null,
		status: model.status || null,
		priority: model.priority || null
	}),
	decode: (model) => {
		const text = (key: string) => {
			const value = model[key];
			if (value === null || value === undefined) return '';
			if (typeof value !== 'string') throw new TypeError(key);
			return value;
		};
		return {
			name: text('name'),
			owner: text('owner') || null,
			status: text('status') || null,
			reference: text('reference'),
			dueDate: model.dueDate === null ? null : text('dueDate'),
			priority: text('priority') || null
		};
	}
};
const labels: Readonly<Record<string, string>> = {
	name: '项目名称',
	reference: '项目编号',
	category: '项目类型',
	team: '所属团队',
	region: '所属区域',
	status: '项目状态',
	budget: '预算（元）',
	progress: '完成进度',
	channels: '通知渠道',
	enabled: '截止提醒',
	tags: '项目标签',
	time: '提醒时间',
	attachments: '交付附件',
	note: '项目说明'
};
const fieldOrder = [
	'name',
	'reference',
	'category',
	'owner',
	'team',
	'region',
	'status',
	'priority',
	'startDate',
	'dueDate',
	'budget',
	'progress',
	'channels',
	'enabled',
	'tags',
	'time',
	'email',
	'attachments',
	'note'
];
// JS 投影也保留返回类型，避免嵌套字段模式推导成庞大联合。
const definitions = fieldOrder.map(
	/** @returns {import('@asam-ui/pro').AsamFieldDefinition} */ (key): AsamFieldDefinition => {
		const field = richFields.find((item) => item.key === key)!;
		const label = labels[field.key] ?? field.label;
		const group = ['name', 'reference', 'category', 'owner', 'team', 'region'].includes(
			field.key
		)
			? '基本信息'
			: ['status', 'priority', 'startDate', 'dueDate', 'budget', 'progress'].includes(
						field.key
				  )
				? '计划安排'
				: ['attachments', 'note'].includes(field.key)
					? '附件与说明'
					: '协作设置';
		const layout = { ...field.modes?.edit?.layout, group };
		const modes = {
			...field.modes,
			edit: { ...field.modes?.edit, layout },
			detail: { ...field.modes?.detail, layout }
		};
		if (field.key === 'email')
			return {
				...field,
				label,
				submitHidden: true,
				submit: (value: unknown) => value,
				modes: {
					...modes,
					edit: { ...modes.edit, hidden: true },
					detail: { ...modes.detail, hidden: true }
				}
			};
		if (field.key === 'region')
			return {
				...field,
				label,
				format: (value: unknown) =>
					value === 'hz' ? '中国 / 浙江 / 杭州' : String(value ?? '—'),
				modes: {
					...modes,
					edit: {
						...modes.edit,
						componentProps: {
							props: { emitPath: false },
							placeholder: '请选择区域',
							options: [
								{
									value: 'cn',
									label: '中国',
									raw: { code: 'cn' },
									children: [
										{
											value: 'zj',
											label: '浙江',
											raw: { code: 'zj' },
											children: [
												{ value: 'hz', label: '杭州', raw: { code: 'hz' } }
											]
										}
									]
								}
							] satisfies readonly AsamOption<string, { code: string }>[]
						}
					}
				}
			};
		if (field.key === 'reference')
			return {
				...field,
				label,
				modes: {
					...modes,
					edit: { ...modes.edit, readonly: false, componentProps: { readonly: true } }
				}
			};
		if (field.key === 'name' || field.key === 'owner')
			return {
				...field,
				label,
				modes: {
					...modes,
					edit: {
						...modes.edit,
						componentProps: {
							placeholder:
								field.key === 'name' ? '请输入项目名称' : '输入或选择负责人'
						}
					}
				}
			};
		if (field.key === 'progress')
			return {
				...field,
				label,
				format: (value: unknown) => `${String(value)}%`,
				modes: {
					...modes,
					edit: {
						...modes.edit,
						componentProps: { ...modes.edit.componentProps, showInput: true }
					}
				}
			};
		if (field.key === 'enabled')
			return {
				...field,
				label: '截止提醒',
				format: (value: unknown) => (value ? '开启' : '关闭'),
				modes: {
					...modes,
					edit: {
						...modes.edit,
						componentProps: { activeText: '已开启', inactiveText: '已关闭' }
					}
				}
			};
		if (field.key === 'tags' || field.key === 'note')
			return {
				...field,
				label,
				modes: {
					...modes,
					edit: {
						...modes.edit,
						componentProps: {
							...modes.edit.componentProps,
							placeholder:
								field.key === 'tags'
									? '输入后按 Enter 添加'
									: '填写目标、交付范围或协作事项',
							...(field.key === 'note' ? { rows: 3 } : {})
						}
					}
				}
			};
		if (field.kind === 'single') {
			const values =
				field.key === 'status'
					? statuses
					: field.key === 'category'
						? ['平台建设', '流程优化', '数据分析']
						: field.key === 'team'
							? ['平台研发组', '客户体验组', '运营协作组']
							: undefined;
			if (values)
				return { ...field, label, source: source(values), control: 'select', modes };
		}
		return { ...field, label, modes };
	}
);
export const projectFields = definitions;
export const projectEditorConfig = {
	editFields: projectFields,
	detailFields: projectFields,
	editCodec: richCodec,
	equals: richEquals
};
function copy(model: RichEdit): RichEdit {
	return richCodec.decode(richCodec.encode(model));
}
function defaults(): RichEdit {
	return richCodec.decode({
		name: '',
		reference: '保存后自动生成',
		owner: '',
		team: '平台研发组',
		category: '平台建设',
		region: 'hz',
		status: '待启动',
		email: '',
		note: '',
		startDate: '2026-10-30',
		dueDate: '2026-11-30',
		priority: '中',
		budget: 0,
		progress: 0
	});
}
/** 仅视觉演示内存服务；控制器、校验和写入入口仍消费正常公共包。 */
export function createProjectMock(empty = false) {
	const rows = new Map<string | number, RichRow>();
	if (!empty)
		for (let index = 0; index < 24; index++) {
			const id = index + 1;
			rows.set(id, {
				...defaults(),
				id,
				version: 1,
				name: names[index % names.length]! + (index >= names.length ? ' · 二期' : ''),
				reference: `PRJ-2026-${String(id).padStart(3, '0')}`,
				owner: owners[index % owners.length]!,
				status: statuses[[0, 1, 0, 2, 3, 0][index % 6]!]!,
				startDate: '2026-10-01',
				dueDate: `2026-11-${String(5 + index).padStart(2, '0')}`,
				priority: index % 3 ? '中' : '高',
				budget: 48000 + index * 3200,
				progress: [68, 0, 42, 100, 35, 76][index % 6]!,
				tags: ['重点项目', '跨团队'],
				attachments: [
					{
						id: `project-spec-${id}`,
						name: '项目交付清单与里程碑计划.pdf',
						url: `/__mock-project-documents__/${id}`,
						mimeType: 'application/pdf',
						size: 1887437
					}
				],
				note: '统一项目计划、交付资料与跨团队协作。当前里程碑为完成核心流程联调，下一阶段进入使用反馈与体验优化。'
			});
		}
	let sequence = 100;
	const applied = new Set<string>();
	const services: AsamCrudServices<RichRow, ProjectQuery, RichEdit, string | number> = {
		async list(request) {
			const filtered = [...rows.values()].filter((row) =>
				Object.entries(request.query).every(
					([key, value]) =>
						!value || String(Reflect.get(row, key) ?? '').includes(String(value))
				)
			);
			return {
				list: filtered
					.slice(
						(request.currentPage - 1) * request.pageSize,
						request.currentPage * request.pageSize
					)
					.map((row) => ({ ...copy(row), id: row.id, version: row.version })),
				total: filtered.length
			};
		},
		async defaults() {
			return defaults();
		},
		async load(key) {
			const row = rows.get(key);
			if (!row) throw new Error('项目已不存在');
			return copy(row);
		},
		async create(model, operation) {
			const id = ++sequence;
			rows.set(id, {
				...copy(model),
				id,
				version: 1,
				reference: `PRJ-2026-${String(id).padStart(3, '0')}`
			});
			applied.add(operation.target.operationId);
			return { status: 'success' };
		},
		async update(key, model, operation) {
			const row = rows.get(key);
			if (!row) return { status: 'failure', message: '项目已不存在' };
			rows.set(key, { ...copy(model), id: key, version: row.version + 1 });
			applied.add(operation.target.operationId);
			return { status: 'success' };
		},
		async verify(operation) {
			return {
				status: applied.has(operation.target.operationId) ? 'success' : 'not-applied'
			};
		},
		async resolve(keys) {
			return keys.map((key) => {
				const row = rows.get(key);
				return row
					? {
							key,
							target: {
								key,
								version: String(row.version),
								payload: { name: row.name }
							}
						}
					: { key, reason: '项目已不存在' };
			});
		},
		async remove(target) {
			rows.delete(target.key);
			return { key: target.key, status: 'success' };
		},
		async verifyRemove(target) {
			return { key: target.key, status: rows.has(target.key) ? 'unsent' : 'success' };
		}
	};
	return {
		services,
		async detail(key: string | number) {
			const row = rows.get(key);
			return row
				? { status: 'ready' as const, data: { ...copy(row) } }
				: { status: 'missing' as const };
		},
		complete(keys: readonly (string | number)[]) {
			for (const key of keys) {
				const row = rows.get(key);
				if (row) rows.set(key, { ...row, status: '已完成', progress: 100 });
			}
		}
	};
}
ts
import {
	AsamCascader,
	AsamDatePicker,
	AsamInputNumber,
	AsamInputTag,
	AsamSlider,
	AsamSwitch,
	AsamTimePicker,
	defineAsamControl,
	defineAsamOptions
} from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamUploadedResource } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamCrudCodec } from '@asam-ui/pro/templates/crud';
import type { AsamFieldDefinition } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import UploadField from './UploadField.vue';
interface BaseEdit {
	name: string;
	team: string;
	status: string;
	owner: string;
	email: string;
	note: string;
}
interface BaseRow extends BaseEdit {
	id: string | number;
	version: number;
}
const baseCodec: AsamCrudCodec<BaseEdit> = {
	encode: (model) => ({ ...model }),
	decode: (model) => {
		const text = (key: keyof BaseEdit) => {
			const value = model[key];
			if (typeof value !== 'string') throw new TypeError(`字段${key}必须为string`);
			return value;
		};
		return {
			name: text('name'),
			team: text('team'),
			status: text('status'),
			owner: text('owner'),
			email: text('email'),
			note: text('note')
		};
	}
};
export interface ExtraFields {
	reference: string;
	category: string;
	region: string | null;
	priority: string;
	startDate: string | null;
	dueDate: string | null;
	budget: number;
	progress: number;
	channels: string[];
	enabled: boolean;
	tags: string[];
	time: string | null;
	attachments: AsamUploadedResource[];
}
export type RichRow = BaseRow & ExtraFields;
export type RichEdit = BaseEdit & ExtraFields;
const defaults = (): ExtraFields => ({

	category: '组件演示',
	region: null,
	priority: '中',
	startDate: '',
	dueDate: '',

	progress: 0,

	tags: [],

	attachments: []

const string = (v: unknown): v is string => typeof v === 'string';
const strings = (v: unknown): v is string[] => Array.isArray(v) && v.every(string);
const finite = (v: unknown): v is number => typeof v === 'number' && Number.isFinite(v);

				typeof Reflect.get(r, 'name') === 'string' &&
				typeof Reflect.get(r, 'url') === 'string' &&

		const value: unknown = Reflect.get(model, key);

	for (const key of ['channels', 'tags'] as const) {

		if (value !== undefined) {

	if (enabled !== undefined) {
		if (typeof enabled !== 'boolean') throw new TypeError('enabled');
		result.enabled = enabled;
	}

}

export const richFields: readonly AsamFieldDefinition[] = editableFields.map((field) => ({
	...field,
	modes: { ...field.modes, detail: { layout: field.modes?.edit?.layout } }
}));

function equalTags(a: unknown, b: unknown): boolean {
	return strings(a) && strings(b) && a.length === b.length && a.every((tag, i) => tag === b[i]);
}
function equalAttachments(a: unknown, b: unknown): boolean {
	return (
		resources(a) &&
		resources(b) &&
		a.length === b.length &&
		a.every((file, i) => {
			const other = b[i]!;
			return (
				file.id === other.id &&
				file.name === other.name &&
				file.url === other.url &&
				file.mimeType === other.mimeType &&
				file.size === other.size
			);
		})
	);
}
/** 比较实际持久化值；数组快照换引用不代表编辑，顺序和资源元数据变化仍需判脏。 */
export const richEquals = Object.freeze({
	region: Object.is,
	startDate: Object.is,
	dueDate: Object.is,
	budget: Object.is,
	progress: Object.is,
	enabled: Object.is,
	tags: equalTags,
	time: Object.is,
	attachments: equalAttachments
});

<template>
	<AsamUpload
		:model-value="modelValue"
		multiple
		:upload="upload"
		:disabled="disabled"
		drag
		@update:model-value="update"
	>
		<p>选择或拖入演示附件</p>
		<template #tip>本地合成上传，不连接真实服务。</template>
	</AsamUpload>
</template>
<script setup lang="ts">
import { AsamUpload } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamUploadedResource, AsamUploadHandler, AsamUploadValue } from '@asam-ui/ui';
defineProps<{ modelValue: readonly AsamUploadedResource[]; disabled?: boolean }>();
const emit = defineEmits<{ 'update:modelValue': [value: AsamUploadedResource[]] }>();
const upload: AsamUploadHandler = async ({ file }, context) => {
	context.reportProgress({ loaded: file.size / 2, total: file.size });
	await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 80));
	if (context.signal.aborted) throw new DOMException('Aborted', 'AbortError');
	context.reportProgress({ loaded: file.size, total: file.size });
	return {
		id: 'demo-' + file.name + '-' + file.size,
		name: file.name,
		url: '/__local-preview__/' + encodeURIComponent(file.name),
		size: file.size,
		mimeType: file.type || 'application/octet-stream'
	};
};
function update(value: AsamUploadValue) {
	if (Array.isArray(value)) emit('update:modelValue', [...value]);
}
</script>

<script setup>
import { h, onBeforeUnmount, shallowRef } from 'vue';

import {
	createAsamWriteCoordinator,
	createAsamTableOperationCoordinator
} from '@asam-ui/pro/components';

	createProjectMock,
	initialProjectQuery,
	projectEditorConfig,
	projectQueryCodec,
	projectQueryFields
} from './project/ProjectMock.js';
defineOptions({ name: 'SharedCrudExample' });
const props = defineProps({
	tableSize: { type: String, required: false },
	size: { type: String, required: false },
	homePreview: { type: Boolean, required: false },
	tableOnly: { type: Boolean, required: false },
	showActionColors: { type: Boolean, required: false }
});
const showBorder = shallowRef(false);
const rowActionMessage = shallowRef('可用行内的「查看编号」核对项目。');
const rowActions = [
	{
		id: 'show-reference',
		label: '查看编号',
		button: { type: 'secondary', plain: true },
		scope: 'independent',

			if (row) rowActionMessage.value = `${row.name}：${row.reference}`;
		}

const mock = createProjectMock();
const runtime = createAsamDataRuntime();

		() => true,
		() => false

		? 'primary'

			? 'success'
			: status === '待启动'
				? 'warning'
				: 'info';
const controller = useAsamCrudController({

	dataset: 'website-projects',

	queryFields: projectQueryFields,
	queryCodec: projectQueryCodec,
	...projectEditorConfig,
	services: mock.services,
	detail: { mode: 'load', load: mock.detail },
	columns: [
		{ key: 'name', label: '项目名称', width: props.homePreview ? 180 : 240, required: true },
		...(!props.tableOnly
			? [
					{
						key: 'reference',
						label: '项目编号',
						width: props.homePreview ? 140 : 150,
						flex: false
					}
				]
			: []),
		{ key: 'owner', label: '负责人', width: props.homePreview ? 84 : 96, flex: false },
		{
			key: 'status',
			label: '状态',
			width: props.homePreview ? 96 : 110,
			flex: false,
			render: (row) =>
				h(AsamTag, { type: tone(row.status), effect: 'light' }, () => row.status)
		},
		{ key: 'dueDate', label: '截止日期', width: props.homePreview ? 96 : 126, flex: false }
	],
	preferences: {
		scope: {
			application: 'docs',
			principal: 'visitor',
			table: 'website-projects',
			version: '2'
		},
		adapter: { load: async () => null, save: async () => {}, reset: async () => {} }
	},
	allowed: () => true,
	allowedRemove: () => true,
	confirmDiscard: () => confirm('放弃未保存内容？'),
	confirmRemove: () => confirm('删除所选项目？'),
	operationId: (action) => `website-${action}-${++sequence}`
});
onBeforeUnmount(() => {
	controller.dispose();

import { defineAsamOptions } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { richCodec, richEquals, richFields } from './RichFields.js';
export const initialProjectQuery = {
	name: '',
	owner: null,
	status: null,
	reference: '',
	dueDate: null,
	priority: null
};
export const owners = ['陈晨', '林悦', '张远', '许宁', '周可', '沈知'];
export const statuses = ['进行中', '待启动', '已完成', '已暂停'];
const names = [
	'华东供应链协同平台',
	'园区设备巡检',
	'研发知识库升级',
	'客户服务工作台',
	'渠道结算自动化',
	'华南仓储可视化',
	'数据治理与指标口径统一',
	'生产计划排程',
	'质量追溯系统',
	'移动审批助手',
	'合同归档与检索',
	'团队协作空间'
];
const source = (values) =>
	defineAsamOptions().static({ options: values.map((value) => ({ value, label: value })) });
const choice = (key, label, values) => ({
	key,
	label,
	kind: 'single',
	source: source(values),
	adaptInput: (value) => {
		if (value === '' || value === null || value === undefined) return null;
		if (
			typeof value === 'string' ||
			typeof value === 'boolean' ||
			(typeof value === 'number' && Number.isFinite(value))
		)
			return value;
		throw new TypeError('选择值必须是合法标量或空值');
	},
	query: (value) => value ?? '',
	modes: { query: { componentProps: { placeholder: '全部', clearable: true } } }
});
export const projectQueryFields = [
	{
		key: 'name',
		label: '项目名称',
		kind: 'text',
		modes: { query: { componentProps: { placeholder: '输入项目名称', clearable: true } } }
	},
	choice('owner', '负责人', owners),
	choice('status', '项目状态', statuses),
	{
		key: 'reference',
		label: '项目编号',
		kind: 'text',
		modes: { query: { componentProps: { placeholder: '如 PRJ-2026-001', clearable: true } } }
	},
	{
		...richFields.find((field) => field.key === 'dueDate'),
		modes: {
			query: {
				componentProps: {
					valueFormat: 'YYYY-MM-DD',
					placeholder: '选择日期',
					clearable: true
				}
			}
		}
	},
	choice('priority', '优先级', ['高', '中', '低'])
];
export const projectQueryCodec = {
	encode: (model) => ({
		...model,
		owner: model.owner || null,
		status: model.status || null,
		priority: model.priority || null
	}),
	decode: (model) => {
		const text = (key) => {
			const value = model[key];
			if (value === null || value === undefined) return '';
			if (typeof value !== 'string') throw new TypeError(key);
			return value;
		};
		return {
			name: text('name'),
			owner: text('owner') || null,
			status: text('status') || null,
			reference: text('reference'),
			dueDate: model.dueDate === null ? null : text('dueDate'),
			priority: text('priority') || null
		};
	}
};
const labels = {
	name: '项目名称',
	reference: '项目编号',
	category: '项目类型',
	team: '所属团队',
	region: '所属区域',
	status: '项目状态',
	budget: '预算（元）',
	progress: '完成进度',
	channels: '通知渠道',
	enabled: '截止提醒',
	tags: '项目标签',
	time: '提醒时间',
	attachments: '交付附件',
	note: '项目说明'
};
const fieldOrder = [
	'name',
	'reference',
	'category',
	'owner',
	'team',
	'region',
	'status',
	'priority',
	'startDate',
	'dueDate',
	'budget',
	'progress',
	'channels',
	'enabled',
	'tags',
	'time',
	'email',
	'attachments',
	'note'
];
// JS 投影也保留返回类型，避免嵌套字段模式推导成庞大联合。
const definitions = fieldOrder.map(
	/** @returns {import('@asam-ui/pro').AsamFieldDefinition} */ (key) => {
		const field = richFields.find((item) => item.key === key);
		const label = labels[field.key] ?? field.label;
		const group = ['name', 'reference', 'category', 'owner', 'team', 'region'].includes(
			field.key
		)
			? '基本信息'
			: ['status', 'priority', 'startDate', 'dueDate', 'budget', 'progress'].includes(
						field.key
				  )
				? '计划安排'
				: ['attachments', 'note'].includes(field.key)
					? '附件与说明'
					: '协作设置';
		const layout = { ...field.modes?.edit?.layout, group };
		const modes = {
			...field.modes,
			edit: { ...field.modes?.edit, layout },
			detail: { ...field.modes?.detail, layout }
		};
		if (field.key === 'email')
			return {
				...field,
				label,
				submitHidden: true,
				submit: (value) => value,
				modes: {
					...modes,
					edit: { ...modes.edit, hidden: true },
					detail: { ...modes.detail, hidden: true }
				}
			};
		if (field.key === 'region')
			return {
				...field,
				label,
				format: (value) => (value === 'hz' ? '中国 / 浙江 / 杭州' : String(value ?? '—')),
				modes: {
					...modes,
					edit: {
						...modes.edit,
						componentProps: {
							props: { emitPath: false },
							placeholder: '请选择区域',
							options: [
								{
									value: 'cn',
									label: '中国',
									raw: { code: 'cn' },
									children: [
										{
											value: 'zj',
											label: '浙江',
											raw: { code: 'zj' },
											children: [
												{ value: 'hz', label: '杭州', raw: { code: 'hz' } }
											]
										}
									]
								}
							]
						}
					}
				}
			};
		if (field.key === 'reference')
			return {
				...field,
				label,
				modes: {
					...modes,
					edit: { ...modes.edit, readonly: false, componentProps: { readonly: true } }
				}
			};
		if (field.key === 'name' || field.key === 'owner')
			return {
				...field,
				label,
				modes: {
					...modes,
					edit: {
						...modes.edit,
						componentProps: {
							placeholder:
								field.key === 'name' ? '请输入项目名称' : '输入或选择负责人'
						}
					}
				}
			};
		if (field.key === 'progress')
			return {
				...field,
				label,
				format: (value) => `${String(value)}%`,
				modes: {
					...modes,
					edit: {
						...modes.edit,
						componentProps: { ...modes.edit.componentProps, showInput: true }
					}
				}
			};
		if (field.key === 'enabled')

/** 仅视觉演示内存服务；控制器、校验和写入入口仍消费正常公共包。 */
export function createProjectMock(empty = false) {
	const rows = new Map();
	if (!empty)
		for (let index = 0; index < 24; index++) {
			const id = index + 1;
			rows.set(id, {
				...defaults(),
				id,
				version: 1,
				name: names[index % names.length] + (index >= names.length ? ' · 二期' : ''),
				reference: `PRJ-2026-${String(id).padStart(3, '0')}`,
				owner: owners[index % owners.length],
				status: statuses[[0, 1, 0, 2, 3, 0][index % 6]],
				startDate: '2026-10-01',
				dueDate: `2026-11-${String(5 + index).padStart(2, '0')}`,
				priority: index % 3 ? '中' : '高',
				budget: 48000 + index * 3200,
				progress: [68, 0, 42, 100, 35, 76][index % 6],
				tags: ['重点项目', '跨团队'],
				attachments: [
					{
						id: `project-spec-${id}`,
						name: '项目交付清单与里程碑计划.pdf',
						url: `/__mock-project-documents__/${id}`,
						mimeType: 'application/pdf',
						size: 1887437
					}
				],
				note: '统一项目计划、交付资料与跨团队协作。当前里程碑为完成核心流程联调，下一阶段进入使用反馈与体验优化。'
			});
		}
	let sequence = 100;
	const applied = new Set();
	const services = {
		async list(request) {
			const filtered = [...rows.values()].filter((row) =>
				Object.entries(request.query).every(
					([key, value]) =>
						!value || String(Reflect.get(row, key) ?? '').includes(String(value))
				)
			);
			return {
				list: filtered
					.slice(
						(request.currentPage - 1) * request.pageSize,
						request.currentPage * request.pageSize
					)
					.map((row) => ({ ...copy(row), id: row.id, version: row.version })),
				total: filtered.length
			};
		},
		async defaults() {
			return defaults();
		},
		async load(key) {
			const row = rows.get(key);
			if (!row) throw new Error('项目已不存在');
			return copy(row);
		},
		async create(model, operation) {
			const id = ++sequence;
			rows.set(id, {
				...copy(model),
				id,
				version: 1,
				reference: `PRJ-2026-${String(id).padStart(3, '0')}`
			});
			applied.add(operation.target.operationId);
			return { status: 'success' };
		},
		async update(key, model, operation) {
			const row = rows.get(key);
			if (!row) return { status: 'failure', message: '项目已不存在' };
			rows.set(key, { ...copy(model), id: key, version: row.version + 1 });
			applied.add(operation.target.operationId);
			return { status: 'success' };
		},
		async verify(operation) {
			return {
				status: applied.has(operation.target.operationId) ? 'success' : 'not-applied'
			};
		},
		async resolve(keys) {
			return keys.map((key) => {
				const row = rows.get(key);
				return row
					? {
							key,
							target: {
								key,
								version: String(row.version),
								payload: { name: row.name }
							}
						}
					: { key, reason: '项目已不存在' };
			});
		},
		async remove(target) {
			rows.delete(target.key);
			return { key: target.key, status: 'success' };
		},
		async verifyRemove(target) {
			return { key: target.key, status: rows.has(target.key) ? 'unsent' : 'success' };
		}
	};
	return {
		services,
		async detail(key) {
			const row = rows.get(key);
			return row ? { status: 'ready', data: { ...copy(row) } } : { status: 'missing' };
		},
		complete(keys) {
			for (const key of keys) {
				const row = rows.get(key);
				if (row) rows.set(key, { ...row, status: '已完成', progress: 100 });
			}
		}
	};
}

		multiple
		:upload="upload"
		:disabled="disabled"
		drag
		@update:model-value="update"

<script setup>
import { AsamUpload } from '@asam-ui/ui';
defineProps({
	modelValue: { type: Array, required: true },
	disabled: { type: Boolean, required: false }
});
const emit = defineEmits(['update:modelValue']);
const upload = async ({ file }, context) => {
	context.reportProgress({ loaded: file.size / 2, total: file.size });
	await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 80));
	if (context.signal.aborted) throw new DOMException('Aborted', 'AbortError');
	context.reportProgress({ loaded: file.size, total: file.size });
	return {
		id: 'demo-' + file.name + '-' + file.size,
		name: file.name,
		url: '/__local-preview__/' + encodeURIComponent(file.name),
		size: file.size,
		mimeType: file.type || 'application/octet-stream'
	};
};
function update(value) {
	if (Array.isArray(value)) emit('update:modelValue', [...value]);
}
</script>

	allowed: () => true,
	allowedRemove: () => true,
	confirmDiscard: () => confirm('放弃未保存内容？'),
	confirmRemove: () => confirm('删除所选项目？'),
	operationId: (action) => `website-${action}-${++sequence}`
});
onBeforeUnmount(() => {
	controller.dispose();
	runtime.invalidate();
});
</script>

const choice = (key: string, label: string, values: readonly string[]): AsamFieldDefinition => ({

const labels: Readonly<Record<string, string>> = {

const fieldOrder = [
	'name',
	'reference',
	'category',
	'owner',
	'team',
	'region',
	'status',
	'priority',
	'startDate',
	'dueDate',
	'budget',
	'progress',
	'channels',
	'enabled',
	'tags',
	'time',
	'email',
	'attachments',

const definitions = fieldOrder.map(
	/** @returns {import('@asam-ui/pro').AsamFieldDefinition} */ (key): AsamFieldDefinition => {
		const field = richFields.find((item) => item.key === key)!;

						field.key
				  )

				...field,

					value === 'hz' ? '中国 / 浙江 / 杭州' : String(value ?? '—'),
				modes: {
					...modes,
					edit: {
						...modes.edit,
						componentProps: {
							props: { emitPath: false },

								{

									label: '中国',
									raw: { code: 'cn' },
									children: [
										{
											value: 'zj',
											label: '浙江',
											raw: { code: 'zj' },
											children: [
												{ value: 'hz', label: '杭州', raw: { code: 'hz' } }
											]
										}
									]
								}
							] satisfies readonly AsamOption<string, { code: string }>[]

			return {
				...field,

					...modes,
					edit: { ...modes.edit, readonly: false, componentProps: { readonly: true } }

			return {
				...field,
				label,
				modes: {
					...modes,
					edit: {
						...modes.edit,
						componentProps: {
							placeholder:
								field.key === 'name' ? '请输入项目名称' : '输入或选择负责人'

				...field,

				modes: {
					...modes,
					edit: {
						...modes.edit,
						componentProps: { ...modes.edit.componentProps, showInput: true }

				}
			};

			return {
				...field,
				label: '截止提醒',
				format: (value: unknown) => (value ? '开启' : '关闭'),
				modes: {

		if (field.key === 'tags' || field.key === 'note')
			return {
				...field,

				modes: {
					...modes,
					edit: {
						...modes.edit,
						componentProps: {
							...modes.edit.componentProps,
							placeholder:
								field.key === 'tags'

			const values =

export const projectFields = definitions;
export const projectEditorConfig = {

	detailFields: projectFields,
	editCodec: richCodec,
	equals: richEquals
};
function copy(model: RichEdit): RichEdit {
	return richCodec.decode(richCodec.encode(model));
}
function defaults(): RichEdit {
	return richCodec.decode({
		name: '',
		reference: '保存后自动生成',
		owner: '',
		team: '平台研发组',
		category: '平台建设',
		region: 'hz',
		status: '待启动',
		email: '',
		note: '',
		startDate: '2026-10-30',
		dueDate: '2026-11-30',
		priority: '中',
		budget: 0,
		progress: 0
	});
}
/** 仅视觉演示内存服务；控制器、校验和写入入口仍消费正常公共包。 */
export function createProjectMock(empty = false) {
	const rows = new Map<string | number, RichRow>();
	if (!empty)
		for (let index = 0; index < 24; index++) {
			const id = index + 1;
			rows.set(id, {
				...defaults(),
				id,
				version: 1,
				name: names[index % names.length]! + (index >= names.length ? ' · 二期' : ''),
				reference: `PRJ-2026-${String(id).padStart(3, '0')}`,
				owner: owners[index % owners.length]!,
				status: statuses[[0, 1, 0, 2, 3, 0][index % 6]!]!,
				startDate: '2026-10-01',
				dueDate: `2026-11-${String(5 + index).padStart(2, '0')}`,
				priority: index % 3 ? '中' : '高',
				budget: 48000 + index * 3200,
				progress: [68, 0, 42, 100, 35, 76][index % 6]!,
				tags: ['重点项目', '跨团队'],
				attachments: [
					{
						id: `project-spec-${id}`,
						name: '项目交付清单与里程碑计划.pdf',
						url: `/__mock-project-documents__/${id}`,
						mimeType: 'application/pdf',
						size: 1887437
					}
				],
				note: '统一项目计划、交付资料与跨团队协作。当前里程碑为完成核心流程联调，下一阶段进入使用反馈与体验优化。'
			});
		}
	let sequence = 100;
	const applied = new Set<string>();
	const services: AsamCrudServices<RichRow, ProjectQuery, RichEdit, string | number> = {
		async list(request) {
			const filtered = [...rows.values()].filter((row) =>
				Object.entries(request.query).every(
					([key, value]) =>
						!value || String(Reflect.get(row, key) ?? '').includes(String(value))
				)
			);
			return {
				list: filtered
					.slice(
						(request.currentPage - 1) * request.pageSize,
						request.currentPage * request.pageSize
					)
					.map((row) => ({ ...copy(row), id: row.id, version: row.version })),
				total: filtered.length
			};
		},
		async defaults() {
			return defaults();
		},
		async load(key) {
			const row = rows.get(key);
			if (!row) throw new Error('项目已不存在');
			return copy(row);
		},
		async create(model, operation) {
			const id = ++sequence;
			rows.set(id, {
				...copy(model),
				id,
				version: 1,
				reference: `PRJ-2026-${String(id).padStart(3, '0')}`
			});
			applied.add(operation.target.operationId);
			return { status: 'success' };
		},
		async update(key, model, operation) {
			const row = rows.get(key);
			if (!row) return { status: 'failure', message: '项目已不存在' };
			rows.set(key, { ...copy(model), id: key, version: row.version + 1 });
			applied.add(operation.target.operationId);
			return { status: 'success' };
		},
		async verify(operation) {
			return {
				status: applied.has(operation.target.operationId) ? 'success' : 'not-applied'
			};
		},
		async resolve(keys) {
			return keys.map((key) => {
				const row = rows.get(key);
				return row
					? {
							key,
							target: {
								key,
								version: String(row.version),
								payload: { name: row.name }
							}
						}
					: { key, reason: '项目已不存在' };
			});
		},
		async remove(target) {
			rows.delete(target.key);
			return { key: target.key, status: 'success' };
		},
		async verifyRemove(target) {
			return { key: target.key, status: rows.has(target.key) ? 'unsent' : 'success' };
		}
	};
	return {
		services,
		async detail(key: string | number) {
			const row = rows.get(key);
			return row
				? { status: 'ready' as const, data: { ...copy(row) } }
				: { status: 'missing' as const };
		},
		complete(keys: readonly (string | number)[]) {
			for (const key of keys) {
				const row = rows.get(key);
				if (row) rows.set(key, { ...row, status: '已完成', progress: 100 });
			}
		}
	};
}

import {
	AsamCascader,
	AsamDatePicker,
	AsamInputNumber,
	AsamInputTag,
	AsamSlider,
	AsamSwitch,
	AsamTimePicker,
	defineAsamControl,
	defineAsamOptions
} from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamUploadedResource } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamCrudCodec } from '@asam-ui/pro/templates/crud';
import type { AsamFieldDefinition } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import UploadField from './UploadField.vue';
interface BaseEdit {
	name: string;
	team: string;
	status: string;
	owner: string;
	email: string;
	note: string;
}
interface BaseRow extends BaseEdit {
	id: string | number;
	version: number;
}
const baseCodec: AsamCrudCodec<BaseEdit> = {
	encode: (model) => ({ ...model }),
	decode: (model) => {
		const text = (key: keyof BaseEdit) => {
			const value = model[key];
			if (typeof value !== 'string') throw new TypeError(`字段${key}必须为string`);
			return value;
		};
		return {
			name: text('name'),
			team: text('team'),
			status: text('status'),
			owner: text('owner'),
			email: text('email'),
			note: text('note')
		};
	}
};
export interface ExtraFields {
	reference: string;
	category: string;
	region: string | null;
	priority: string;
	startDate: string | null;
	dueDate: string | null;
	budget: number;
	progress: number;
	channels: string[];
	enabled: boolean;
	tags: string[];
	time: string | null;
	attachments: AsamUploadedResource[];
}
export type RichRow = BaseRow & ExtraFields;
export type RichEdit = BaseEdit & ExtraFields;
const defaults = (): ExtraFields => ({
	reference: 'LOCAL-DEMO',
	category: '组件演示',
	region: null,
	priority: '中',
	startDate: '',
	dueDate: '',
	budget: 0,
	progress: 0,
	channels: [],
	enabled: false,
	tags: [],
	time: '09:00',
	attachments: []
});
const string = (v: unknown): v is string => typeof v === 'string';
const strings = (v: unknown): v is string[] => Array.isArray(v) && v.every(string);
const finite = (v: unknown): v is number => typeof v === 'number' && Number.isFinite(v);
function resources(v: unknown): v is AsamUploadedResource[] {
	return (
		Array.isArray(v) &&
		v.every(
			(r: unknown) =>
				!!r &&
				typeof r === 'object' &&
				typeof Reflect.get(r, 'id') === 'string' &&
				typeof Reflect.get(r, 'name') === 'string' &&
				typeof Reflect.get(r, 'url') === 'string' &&
				typeof Reflect.get(r, 'mimeType') === 'string' &&
				finite(Reflect.get(r, 'size')) &&
				Reflect.get(r, 'size') >= 0
		)
	);
}
function extras(model: object): ExtraFields {
	const result = defaults();
	for (const key of ['reference', 'category', 'priority'] as const) {
		const value: unknown = Reflect.get(model, key);
		if (value !== undefined) {
			if (!string(value)) throw new TypeError(key);
			result[key] = value;
		}
	}
	for (const key of ['region', 'startDate', 'dueDate', 'time'] as const) {
		const value: unknown = Reflect.get(model, key);
		if (value !== undefined) {
			if (value !== null && !string(value)) throw new TypeError(key);
			result[key] = value;
		}
	}
	for (const key of ['budget', 'progress'] as const) {
		const value: unknown = Reflect.get(model, key);
		if (value !== undefined) {
			if (!finite(value)) throw new TypeError(key);
			result[key] = value;
		}
	}
	for (const key of ['channels', 'tags'] as const) {
		const value: unknown = Reflect.get(model, key);
		if (value !== undefined) {
			if (!strings(value)) throw new TypeError(key);
			result[key] = [...value];
		}
	}
	const enabled: unknown = Reflect.get(model, 'enabled');
	if (enabled !== undefined) {
		if (typeof enabled !== 'boolean') throw new TypeError('enabled');
		result.enabled = enabled;
	}
	const files: unknown = Reflect.get(model, 'attachments');
	if (files !== undefined) {
		if (!resources(files)) throw new TypeError('attachments');
		result.attachments = files.map((file) => ({ ...file }));
	}
	return result;
}
export const richCodec: AsamCrudCodec<RichEdit> = {
	encode: (model) => ({
		...model,
		channels: [...model.channels],
		tags: [...model.tags],
		attachments: model.attachments.map((file) => ({ ...file }))
	}),
	decode: (model) => ({ ...baseCodec.decode(model), ...extras(model) })
};
const source = (values: readonly string[]) =>
	defineAsamOptions().static({ options: values.map((value) => ({ value, label: value })) });
function custom(
	key: keyof ExtraFields,
	label: string,
	component:
		| typeof AsamDatePicker
		| typeof AsamCascader
		| typeof AsamInputNumber
		| typeof AsamSlider
		| typeof AsamSwitch
		| typeof AsamInputTag
		| typeof AsamTimePicker
		| typeof UploadField,
	valid: (value: unknown) => boolean,
	empty: () => unknown,
	group: string,
	componentProps: Readonly<Record<string, unknown>> = {},
	span?: 1 | 2 | 3
): AsamFieldDefinition {
	return {
		key,
		label,
		kind: 'custom',
		control: defineAsamControl<unknown, object>({
			component,
			emptyValue: empty,
			sourceKinds: []
		}),
		isValue: valid,
		emptyValue: empty,
		isEmpty: (value) =>
			value == null || value === '' || (Array.isArray(value) && !value.length),
		format: (value) =>
			Array.isArray(value)
				? value
						.map((item) =>
							item && typeof item === 'object' && 'name' in item
								? String(item.name)
								: String(item)
						)
						.join('、')
				: String(value ?? '—'),
		query: (value) => value,
		submit: (value) => value,
		modes: { edit: { componentProps, layout: { group, ...(span ? { span } : {}) } } }
	};
}
const nullableString = (value: unknown) => value === null || string(value);
const editableFields: readonly AsamFieldDefinition[] = [
	{
		key: 'name',
		kind: 'text',
		label: '名称',

	{

	custom('region', '地区', AsamCascader, nullableString, () => null, '计划与进度', {

		options: [
			{

		kind: 'single',
		control: 'radio',
		label: '优先级',
		source: source(['高', '中', '低']),
		modes: { edit: { layout: { group: '计划与进度' } } }
	},
	custom('startDate', '开始日期', AsamDatePicker, nullableString, () => '', '计划与进度', {
		type: 'date',
		valueFormat: 'YYYY-MM-DD'
	}),
	custom('dueDate', '截止日期', AsamDatePicker, nullableString, () => '', '计划与进度', {
		type: 'date',
		valueFormat: 'YYYY-MM-DD'
	}),
	custom('budget', '预算', AsamInputNumber, finite, () => 0, '计划与进度', {
		min: 0,
		controlsPosition: 'right'
	}),
	custom('progress', '进度', AsamSlider, finite, () => 0, '计划与进度', { min: 0, max: 100 }),
	{
		key: 'channels',
		kind: 'multiple',
		control: 'checkbox',
		label: '通知渠道',
		source: source(['站内消息', '邮件']),
		modes: { edit: { layout: { group: '协作设置' } } }
	},
	custom(

	custom('time', '提醒时间', AsamTimePicker, nullableString, () => '', '协作设置', {

		kind: 'text',
		label: '联系邮箱',

	custom('attachments', '附件', UploadField, resources, () => [], '附件与备注', {}, 2),
	{

		kind: 'textarea',
		label: '备注',
		modes: { edit: { layout: { group: '附件与备注', span: 2 } } }

export const richFields: readonly AsamFieldDefinition[] = editableFields.map((field) => ({
	...field,
	modes: { ...field.modes, detail: { layout: field.modes?.edit?.layout } }
}));

function equalTags(a: unknown, b: unknown): boolean {
	return strings(a) && strings(b) && a.length === b.length && a.every((tag, i) => tag === b[i]);
}
function equalAttachments(a: unknown, b: unknown): boolean {
	return (
		resources(a) &&
		resources(b) &&
		a.length === b.length &&
		a.every((file, i) => {
			const other = b[i]!;
			return (
				file.id === other.id &&
				file.name === other.name &&
				file.url === other.url &&
				file.mimeType === other.mimeType &&
				file.size === other.size
			);
		})
	);
}
/** 比较实际持久化值；数组快照换引用不代表编辑，顺序和资源元数据变化仍需判脏。 */
export const richEquals = Object.freeze({
	region: Object.is,
	startDate: Object.is,
	dueDate: Object.is,
	budget: Object.is,
	progress: Object.is,
	enabled: Object.is,
	tags: equalTags,
	time: Object.is,
	attachments: equalAttachments
});

<template>
	<AsamUpload
		:model-value="modelValue"
		multiple
		:upload="upload"
		:disabled="disabled"
		drag
		@update:model-value="update"
	>
		<p>选择或拖入演示附件</p>
		<template #tip>本地合成上传，不连接真实服务。</template>
	</AsamUpload>
</template>
<script setup lang="ts">
import { AsamUpload } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamUploadedResource, AsamUploadHandler, AsamUploadValue } from '@asam-ui/ui';
defineProps<{ modelValue: readonly AsamUploadedResource[]; disabled?: boolean }>();
const emit = defineEmits<{ 'update:modelValue': [value: AsamUploadedResource[]] }>();
const upload: AsamUploadHandler = async ({ file }, context) => {
	context.reportProgress({ loaded: file.size / 2, total: file.size });
	await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 80));
	if (context.signal.aborted) throw new DOMException('Aborted', 'AbortError');
	context.reportProgress({ loaded: file.size, total: file.size });
	return {
		id: 'demo-' + file.name + '-' + file.size,
		name: file.name,
		url: '/__local-preview__/' + encodeURIComponent(file.name),
		size: file.size,
		mimeType: file.type || 'application/octet-stream'
	};
};
function update(value: AsamUploadValue) {
	if (Array.isArray(value)) emit('update:modelValue', [...value]);
}
</script>

const labels = {

	'category',
	'owner',

	'status',
	'priority',
	'startDate',
	'dueDate',
	'budget',

		if (field.key === 'region')

				modes: {

							options: [
								{
									value: 'cn',

									raw: { code: 'cn' },
									children: [
										{
											value: 'zj',
											label: '浙江',
											raw: { code: 'zj' },
											children: [
												{ value: 'hz', label: '杭州', raw: { code: 'hz' } }

										}
									]
								}
							]
						}
					}
				}

		if (field.key === 'reference')
			return {
				...field,

				modes: {
					...modes,
					edit: { ...modes.edit, readonly: false, componentProps: { readonly: true } }

		if (field.key === 'name' || field.key === 'owner')

		if (field.key === 'progress')

		if (field.key === 'enabled')

				modes: {
					...modes,

export const projectFields = definitions;
export const projectEditorConfig = {

	detailFields: projectFields,

	equals: richEquals

function copy(model) {
	return richCodec.decode(richCodec.encode(model));
}
function defaults() {
	return richCodec.decode({
		name: '',
		reference: '保存后自动生成',
		owner: '',
		team: '平台研发组',
		category: '平台建设',
		region: 'hz',
		status: '待启动',
		email: '',
		note: '',
		startDate: '2026-10-30',
		dueDate: '2026-11-30',
		priority: '中',
		budget: 0,
		progress: 0
	});
}
/** 仅视觉演示内存服务；控制器、校验和写入入口仍消费正常公共包。 */
export function createProjectMock(empty = false) {
	const rows = new Map();
	if (!empty)
		for (let index = 0; index < 24; index++) {
			const id = index + 1;
			rows.set(id, {
				...defaults(),
				id,
				version: 1,
				name: names[index % names.length] + (index >= names.length ? ' · 二期' : ''),
				reference: `PRJ-2026-${String(id).padStart(3, '0')}`,
				owner: owners[index % owners.length],
				status: statuses[[0, 1, 0, 2, 3, 0][index % 6]],
				startDate: '2026-10-01',
				dueDate: `2026-11-${String(5 + index).padStart(2, '0')}`,
				priority: index % 3 ? '中' : '高',
				budget: 48000 + index * 3200,
				progress: [68, 0, 42, 100, 35, 76][index % 6],
				tags: ['重点项目', '跨团队'],
				attachments: [
					{
						id: `project-spec-${id}`,
						name: '项目交付清单与里程碑计划.pdf',
						url: `/__mock-project-documents__/${id}`,
						mimeType: 'application/pdf',
						size: 1887437
					}
				],
				note: '统一项目计划、交付资料与跨团队协作。当前里程碑为完成核心流程联调，下一阶段进入使用反馈与体验优化。'
			});
		}
	let sequence = 100;
	const applied = new Set();
	const services = {
		async list(request) {
			const filtered = [...rows.values()].filter((row) =>
				Object.entries(request.query).every(
					([key, value]) =>
						!value || String(Reflect.get(row, key) ?? '').includes(String(value))
				)
			);
			return {
				list: filtered
					.slice(
						(request.currentPage - 1) * request.pageSize,
						request.currentPage * request.pageSize
					)
					.map((row) => ({ ...copy(row), id: row.id, version: row.version })),
				total: filtered.length
			};
		},
		async defaults() {
			return defaults();
		},
		async load(key) {
			const row = rows.get(key);
			if (!row) throw new Error('项目已不存在');
			return copy(row);
		},
		async create(model, operation) {
			const id = ++sequence;
			rows.set(id, {
				...copy(model),
				id,
				version: 1,
				reference: `PRJ-2026-${String(id).padStart(3, '0')}`
			});
			applied.add(operation.target.operationId);
			return { status: 'success' };
		},
		async update(key, model, operation) {
			const row = rows.get(key);
			if (!row) return { status: 'failure', message: '项目已不存在' };
			rows.set(key, { ...copy(model), id: key, version: row.version + 1 });
			applied.add(operation.target.operationId);
			return { status: 'success' };
		},
		async verify(operation) {
			return {
				status: applied.has(operation.target.operationId) ? 'success' : 'not-applied'
			};
		},
		async resolve(keys) {
			return keys.map((key) => {
				const row = rows.get(key);
				return row
					? {
							key,
							target: {
								key,
								version: String(row.version),
								payload: { name: row.name }
							}
						}
					: { key, reason: '项目已不存在' };
			});
		},
		async remove(target) {
			rows.delete(target.key);
			return { key: target.key, status: 'success' };
		},
		async verifyRemove(target) {
			return { key: target.key, status: rows.has(target.key) ? 'unsent' : 'success' };
		}
	};
	return {
		services,
		async detail(key) {
			const row = rows.get(key);
			return row ? { status: 'ready', data: { ...copy(row) } } : { status: 'missing' };
		},
		complete(keys) {
			for (const key of keys) {
				const row = rows.get(key);
				if (row) rows.set(key, { ...row, status: '已完成', progress: 100 });
			}
		}
	};
}

const baseCodec = {

		};

			team: text('team'),
			status: text('status'),
			owner: text('owner'),
			email: text('email'),
			note: text('note')

};
const defaults = () => ({

	progress: 0,

	tags: [],

const finite = (v) => typeof v === 'number' && Number.isFinite(v);

function extras(model) {

		const value = Reflect.get(model, key);
		if (value !== undefined) {
			if (value !== null && !string(value)) throw new TypeError(key);
			result[key] = value;
		}

		if (value !== undefined) {

		}

}
export const richCodec = {

const source = (values) =>
	defineAsamOptions().static({ options: values.map((value) => ({ value, label: value })) });
function custom(key, label, component, valid, empty, group, componentProps = {}, span) {

		control: defineAsamControl({

}
const nullableString = (value) => value === null || string(value);
const editableFields = [
	{
		key: 'name',
		kind: 'text',
		label: '名称',
		modes: {
			edit: {
				rules: [{ required: true, message: '请输入名称' }],

	},
	{

		label: '本地编号',

	},
	{

		label: '团队',

	{

		label: '状态',

	},
	{
		key: 'owner',
		kind: 'text',
		label: '负责人',
		modes: { edit: { layout: { group: '基本信息' } } }
	},
	{

		kind: 'single',
		label: '分类',
		source: source(['组件演示', '流程管理', '数据分析']),
		modes: { edit: { layout: { group: '基本信息' } } }

	custom('region', '地区', AsamCascader, nullableString, () => null, '计划与进度', {

		modes: { edit: { layout: { group: '计划与进度' } } }

	{

	},
	custom(

		'启用提醒',

		(value) => typeof value === 'boolean',
		() => false,
		'协作设置'
	),
	custom('tags', '标签', AsamInputTag, strings, () => [], '协作设置', { validateEvent: false }),
	custom('time', '提醒时间', AsamTimePicker, nullableString, () => '', '协作设置', {
		format: 'HH:mm',
		valueFormat: 'HH:mm'
	}),
	{
		key: 'email',
		kind: 'text',
		label: '联系邮箱',
		modes: { edit: { layout: { group: '协作设置' } } }
	},
	custom('attachments', '附件', UploadField, resources, () => [], '附件与备注', {}, 2),
	{
		key: 'note',
		kind: 'textarea',

		modes: { edit: { layout: { group: '附件与备注', span: 2 } } }

export const richFields = editableFields.map((field) => ({
	...field,
	modes: { ...field.modes, detail: { layout: field.modes?.edit?.layout } }

function equalTags(a, b) {
	return strings(a) && strings(b) && a.length === b.length && a.every((tag, i) => tag === b[i]);
}

	return (
		resources(a) &&
		resources(b) &&
		a.length === b.length &&
		a.every((file, i) => {
			const other = b[i];
			return (
				file.id === other.id &&
				file.name === other.name &&

				file.mimeType === other.mimeType &&

	region: Object.is,
	startDate: Object.is,
	dueDate: Object.is,
	budget: Object.is,
	progress: Object.is,
	enabled: Object.is,
	tags: equalTags,
	time: Object.is,
	attachments: equalAttachments
});

<template>
	<AsamUpload
		:model-value="modelValue"
		multiple
		:upload="upload"
		:disabled="disabled"
		drag
		@update:model-value="update"
	>
		<p>选择或拖入演示附件</p>
		<template #tip>本地合成上传，不连接真实服务。</template>
	</AsamUpload>
</template>
<script setup>
import { AsamUpload } from '@asam-ui/ui';
defineProps({
	modelValue: { type: Array, required: true },
	disabled: { type: Boolean, required: false }
});
const emit = defineEmits(['update:modelValue']);
const upload = async ({ file }, context) => {
	context.reportProgress({ loaded: file.size / 2, total: file.size });
	await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 80));
	if (context.signal.aborted) throw new DOMException('Aborted', 'AbortError');
	context.reportProgress({ loaded: file.size, total: file.size });
	return {
		id: 'demo-' + file.name + '-' + file.size,
		name: file.name,
		url: '/__local-preview__/' + encodeURIComponent(file.name),
		size: file.size,
		mimeType: file.type || 'application/octet-stream'
	};
};
function update(value) {
	if (Array.isArray(value)) emit('update:modelValue', [...value]);
}
</script>

import { AsamCrudPage, useAsamCrudController } from '@asam-ui/pro/templates/crud';
import {
	createAsamWriteCoordinator,
	createAsamTableOperationCoordinator
} from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import type { AsamListAction } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import {
	createProjectMock,
	initialProjectQuery,
	projectEditorConfig,
	projectQueryCodec,
	projectQueryFields
} from './project/ProjectMock.js';
import type { ProjectQuery } from './project/ProjectMock.js';
import type { RichEdit, RichRow } from './project/RichFields.js';

defineOptions({ name: 'SharedCrudExample' });
const props = defineProps<{
	tableSize?: AsamTableSize;
	size?: AsamControlSize;
	homePreview?: boolean;
	tableOnly?: boolean;
	showActionColors?: boolean;
}>();
const showBorder = shallowRef(false);
const rowActionMessage = shallowRef('可用行内的「查看编号」核对项目。');
const rowActions: readonly AsamListAction<RichRow>[] = [
	{
		id: 'show-reference',
		label: '查看编号',
		button: { type: 'secondary', plain: true },
		scope: 'independent',
		run: async ({ row }) => {
			if (row) rowActionMessage.value = `${row.name}：${row.reference}`;
		}
	}

const mock = createProjectMock();
const runtime = createAsamDataRuntime();
let sequence = 0;

		() => false

	...projectEditorConfig,

	columns: [

		...(!props.tableOnly
			? [
					{
						key: 'reference' as const,
						label: '项目编号',
						width: props.homePreview ? 140 : 150,
						flex: false
					}
				]
			: []),
		{ key: 'owner', label: '负责人', width: props.homePreview ? 84 : 96, flex: false },
		{
			key: 'status',
			label: '状态',
			width: props.homePreview ? 96 : 110,
			flex: false,
			render: (row: RichRow) =>
				h(AsamTag, { type: tone(row.status), effect: 'light' }, () => row.status)
		},
		{ key: 'dueDate', label: '截止日期', width: props.homePreview ? 96 : 126, flex: false }
	],
	preferences: {
		scope: {
			application: 'docs',
			principal: 'visitor',
			table: 'website-projects',
			version: '2'
		},
		adapter: { load: async () => null, save: async () => {}, reset: async () => {} }
	},
	allowed: () => true,
	allowedRemove: () => true,
	confirmDiscard: () => confirm('放弃未保存内容？'),
	confirmRemove: () => confirm('删除所选项目？'),
	operationId: (action) => `website-${action}-${++sequence}`

onBeforeUnmount(() => {

import type { AsamCrudCodec, AsamCrudServices } from '@asam-ui/pro/templates/crud';
import type { AsamFieldDefinition } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import { defineAsamOptions } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamOption } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { richCodec, richEquals, richFields } from './RichFields.js';
import type { RichEdit, RichRow } from './RichFields.js';

export interface ProjectQuery {
	name: string;
	owner: string | null;
	status: string | null;
	reference: string;
	dueDate: string | null;
	priority: string | null;
}
export const initialProjectQuery: ProjectQuery = {
	name: '',
	owner: null,
	status: null,
	reference: '',
	dueDate: null,
	priority: null
};
export const owners = ['陈晨', '林悦', '张远', '许宁', '周可', '沈知'];
export const statuses = ['进行中', '待启动', '已完成', '已暂停'];
const names = [
	'华东供应链协同平台',
	'园区设备巡检',
	'研发知识库升级',
	'客户服务工作台',
	'渠道结算自动化',
	'华南仓储可视化',
	'数据治理与指标口径统一',
	'生产计划排程',
	'质量追溯系统',
	'移动审批助手',
	'合同归档与检索',
	'团队协作空间'
];
const source = (values: readonly string[]) =>
	defineAsamOptions().static({ options: values.map((value) => ({ value, label: value })) });
const choice = (key: string, label: string, values: readonly string[]): AsamFieldDefinition => ({
	key,
	label,
	kind: 'single',
	source: source(values),
	adaptInput: (value) => {
		if (value === '' || value === null || value === undefined) return null;
		if (
			typeof value === 'string' ||
			typeof value === 'boolean' ||
			(typeof value === 'number' && Number.isFinite(value))
		)
			return value;
		throw new TypeError('选择值必须是合法标量或空值');
	},
	query: (value) => value ?? '',
	modes: { query: { componentProps: { placeholder: '全部', clearable: true } } }
});
export const projectQueryFields: readonly AsamFieldDefinition[] = [
	{
		key: 'name',
		label: '项目名称',
		kind: 'text',
		modes: { query: { componentProps: { placeholder: '输入项目名称', clearable: true } } }
	},
	choice('owner', '负责人', owners),
	choice('status', '项目状态', statuses),
	{
		key: 'reference',
		label: '项目编号',
		kind: 'text',
		modes: { query: { componentProps: { placeholder: '如 PRJ-2026-001', clearable: true } } }
	},
	{
		...richFields.find((field) => field.key === 'dueDate')!,
		modes: {
			query: {
				componentProps: {
					valueFormat: 'YYYY-MM-DD',
					placeholder: '选择日期',
					clearable: true
				}
			}
		}
	},
	choice('priority', '优先级', ['高', '中', '低'])
];
export const projectQueryCodec: AsamCrudCodec<ProjectQuery> = {
	encode: (model) => ({
		...model,
		owner: model.owner || null,
		status: model.status || null,
		priority: model.priority || null
	}),
	decode: (model) => {
		const text = (key: string) => {
			const value = model[key];
			if (value === null || value === undefined) return '';
			if (typeof value !== 'string') throw new TypeError(key);
			return value;
		};
		return {
			name: text('name'),
			owner: text('owner') || null,
			status: text('status') || null,
			reference: text('reference'),
			dueDate: model.dueDate === null ? null : text('dueDate'),
			priority: text('priority') || null
		};
	}
};
const labels: Readonly<Record<string, string>> = {
	name: '项目名称',
	reference: '项目编号',
	category: '项目类型',
	team: '所属团队',
	region: '所属区域',
	status: '项目状态',
	budget: '预算（元）',
	progress: '完成进度',
	channels: '通知渠道',
	enabled: '截止提醒',
	tags: '项目标签',
	time: '提醒时间',
	attachments: '交付附件',
	note: '项目说明'
};
const fieldOrder = [
	'name',
	'reference',
	'category',
	'owner',
	'team',
	'region',
	'status',
	'priority',
	'startDate',
	'dueDate',
	'budget',
	'progress',
	'channels',
	'enabled',
	'tags',
	'time',
	'email',
	'attachments',
	'note'
];
// JS 投影也保留返回类型，避免嵌套字段模式推导成庞大联合。
const definitions = fieldOrder.map(
	/** @returns {import('@asam-ui/pro').AsamFieldDefinition} */ (key): AsamFieldDefinition => {
		const field = richFields.find((item) => item.key === key)!;
		const label = labels[field.key] ?? field.label;
		const group = ['name', 'reference', 'category', 'owner', 'team', 'region'].includes(
			field.key
		)
			? '基本信息'
			: ['status', 'priority', 'startDate', 'dueDate', 'budget', 'progress'].includes(
						field.key
				  )
				? '计划安排'
				: ['attachments', 'note'].includes(field.key)
					? '附件与说明'
					: '协作设置';
		const layout = { ...field.modes?.edit?.layout, group };
		const modes = {

					edit: { ...modes.edit, hidden: true },
					detail: { ...modes.detail, hidden: true }
				}
			};
		if (field.key === 'region')
			return {
				...field,
				label,
				format: (value: unknown) =>
					value === 'hz' ? '中国 / 浙江 / 杭州' : String(value ?? '—'),
				modes: {

/** 仅视觉演示内存服务；控制器、校验和写入入口仍消费正常公共包。 */
export function createProjectMock(empty = false) {
	const rows = new Map<string | number, RichRow>();
	if (!empty)
		for (let index = 0; index < 24; index++) {
			const id = index + 1;
			rows.set(id, {
				...defaults(),
				id,
				version: 1,
				name: names[index % names.length]! + (index >= names.length ? ' · 二期' : ''),
				reference: `PRJ-2026-${String(id).padStart(3, '0')}`,
				owner: owners[index % owners.length]!,
				status: statuses[[0, 1, 0, 2, 3, 0][index % 6]!]!,
				startDate: '2026-10-01',
				dueDate: `2026-11-${String(5 + index).padStart(2, '0')}`,
				priority: index % 3 ? '中' : '高',
				budget: 48000 + index * 3200,
				progress: [68, 0, 42, 100, 35, 76][index % 6]!,
				tags: ['重点项目', '跨团队'],
				attachments: [
					{
						id: `project-spec-${id}`,
						name: '项目交付清单与里程碑计划.pdf',
						url: `/__mock-project-documents__/${id}`,
						mimeType: 'application/pdf',
						size: 1887437
					}
				],
				note: '统一项目计划、交付资料与跨团队协作。当前里程碑为完成核心流程联调，下一阶段进入使用反馈与体验优化。'
			});
		}
	let sequence = 100;
	const applied = new Set<string>();
	const services: AsamCrudServices<RichRow, ProjectQuery, RichEdit, string | number> = {
		async list(request) {
			const filtered = [...rows.values()].filter((row) =>
				Object.entries(request.query).every(
					([key, value]) =>
						!value || String(Reflect.get(row, key) ?? '').includes(String(value))
				)
			);
			return {
				list: filtered
					.slice(
						(request.currentPage - 1) * request.pageSize,
						request.currentPage * request.pageSize
					)
					.map((row) => ({ ...copy(row), id: row.id, version: row.version })),
				total: filtered.length
			};
		},
		async defaults() {
			return defaults();
		},
		async load(key) {
			const row = rows.get(key);
			if (!row) throw new Error('项目已不存在');
			return copy(row);
		},
		async create(model, operation) {
			const id = ++sequence;
			rows.set(id, {
				...copy(model),
				id,
				version: 1,
				reference: `PRJ-2026-${String(id).padStart(3, '0')}`
			});
			applied.add(operation.target.operationId);
			return { status: 'success' };
		},
		async update(key, model, operation) {
			const row = rows.get(key);
			if (!row) return { status: 'failure', message: '项目已不存在' };
			rows.set(key, { ...copy(model), id: key, version: row.version + 1 });
			applied.add(operation.target.operationId);
			return { status: 'success' };
		},
		async verify(operation) {
			return {
				status: applied.has(operation.target.operationId) ? 'success' : 'not-applied'
			};
		},
		async resolve(keys) {
			return keys.map((key) => {
				const row = rows.get(key);
				return row
					? {
							key,
							target: {
								key,
								version: String(row.version),
								payload: { name: row.name }
							}
						}
					: { key, reason: '项目已不存在' };
			});
		},
		async remove(target) {
			rows.delete(target.key);
			return { key: target.key, status: 'success' };
		},
		async verifyRemove(target) {
			return { key: target.key, status: rows.has(target.key) ? 'unsent' : 'success' };
		}
	};
	return {
		services,
		async detail(key: string | number) {
			const row = rows.get(key);
			return row
				? { status: 'ready' as const, data: { ...copy(row) } }
				: { status: 'missing' as const };
		},
		complete(keys: readonly (string | number)[]) {
			for (const key of keys) {
				const row = rows.get(key);
				if (row) rows.set(key, { ...row, status: '已完成', progress: 100 });
			}
		}
	};
}

import {

	AsamDatePicker,
	AsamInputNumber,
	AsamInputTag,

	AsamSwitch,
	AsamTimePicker,

	defineAsamOptions
} from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamUploadedResource } from '@asam-ui/ui';

import type { AsamFieldDefinition } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import UploadField from './UploadField.vue';
interface BaseEdit {
	name: string;
	team: string;
	status: string;
	owner: string;
	email: string;
	note: string;
}
interface BaseRow extends BaseEdit {
	id: string | number;
	version: number;
}
const baseCodec: AsamCrudCodec<BaseEdit> = {
	encode: (model) => ({ ...model }),
	decode: (model) => {
		const text = (key: keyof BaseEdit) => {
			const value = model[key];
			if (typeof value !== 'string') throw new TypeError(`字段${key}必须为string`);
			return value;
		};
		return {
			name: text('name'),
			team: text('team'),
			status: text('status'),
			owner: text('owner'),
			email: text('email'),
			note: text('note')
		};
	}
};
export interface ExtraFields {
	reference: string;
	category: string;
	region: string | null;
	priority: string;
	startDate: string | null;
	dueDate: string | null;
	budget: number;
	progress: number;

	enabled: boolean;
	tags: string[];
	time: string | null;
	attachments: AsamUploadedResource[];
}
export type RichRow = BaseRow & ExtraFields;
export type RichEdit = BaseEdit & ExtraFields;
const defaults = (): ExtraFields => ({
	reference: 'LOCAL-DEMO',
	category: '组件演示',
	region: null,
	priority: '中',
	startDate: '',
	dueDate: '',
	budget: 0,
	progress: 0,
	channels: [],
	enabled: false,
	tags: [],
	time: '09:00',
	attachments: []
});
const string = (v: unknown): v is string => typeof v === 'string';
const strings = (v: unknown): v is string[] => Array.isArray(v) && v.every(string);
const finite = (v: unknown): v is number => typeof v === 'number' && Number.isFinite(v);
function resources(v: unknown): v is AsamUploadedResource[] {
	return (
		Array.isArray(v) &&
		v.every(
			(r: unknown) =>
				!!r &&
				typeof r === 'object' &&
				typeof Reflect.get(r, 'id') === 'string' &&
				typeof Reflect.get(r, 'name') === 'string' &&
				typeof Reflect.get(r, 'url') === 'string' &&
				typeof Reflect.get(r, 'mimeType') === 'string' &&
				finite(Reflect.get(r, 'size')) &&
				Reflect.get(r, 'size') >= 0
		)
	);
}
function extras(model: object): ExtraFields {
	const result = defaults();
	for (const key of ['reference', 'category', 'priority'] as const) {
		const value: unknown = Reflect.get(model, key);
		if (value !== undefined) {
			if (!string(value)) throw new TypeError(key);
			result[key] = value;
		}
	}
	for (const key of ['region', 'startDate', 'dueDate', 'time'] as const) {
		const value: unknown = Reflect.get(model, key);
		if (value !== undefined) {
			if (value !== null && !string(value)) throw new TypeError(key);
			result[key] = value;
		}
	}
	for (const key of ['budget', 'progress'] as const) {
		const value: unknown = Reflect.get(model, key);
		if (value !== undefined) {
			if (!finite(value)) throw new TypeError(key);
			result[key] = value;
		}
	}
	for (const key of ['channels', 'tags'] as const) {
		const value: unknown = Reflect.get(model, key);
		if (value !== undefined) {
			if (!strings(value)) throw new TypeError(key);
			result[key] = [...value];

	if (enabled !== undefined) {
		if (typeof enabled !== 'boolean') throw new TypeError('enabled');
		result.enabled = enabled;

export const richCodec: AsamCrudCodec<RichEdit> = {
	encode: (model) => ({
		...model,
		channels: [...model.channels],
		tags: [...model.tags],
		attachments: model.attachments.map((file) => ({ ...file }))

	decode: (model) => ({ ...baseCodec.decode(model), ...extras(model) })
};
const source = (values: readonly string[]) =>
	defineAsamOptions().static({ options: values.map((value) => ({ value, label: value })) });
function custom(

		| typeof AsamInputTag
		| typeof AsamTimePicker

	valid: (value: unknown) => boolean,
	empty: () => unknown,
	group: string,
	componentProps: Readonly<Record<string, unknown>> = {},

): AsamFieldDefinition {
	return {
		key,
		label,
		kind: 'custom',
		control: defineAsamControl<unknown, object>({
			component,
			emptyValue: empty,
			sourceKinds: []

		isValue: valid,
		emptyValue: empty,
		isEmpty: (value) =>
			value == null || value === '' || (Array.isArray(value) && !value.length),
		format: (value) =>

						.map((item) =>
							item && typeof item === 'object' && 'name' in item
								? String(item.name)

const nullableString = (value: unknown) => value === null || string(value);

export const richFields: readonly AsamFieldDefinition[] = editableFields.map((field) => ({

function equalTags(a: unknown, b: unknown): boolean {
	return strings(a) && strings(b) && a.length === b.length && a.every((tag, i) => tag === b[i]);
}
function equalAttachments(a: unknown, b: unknown): boolean {
	return (
		resources(a) &&
		resources(b) &&
		a.length === b.length &&
		a.every((file, i) => {
			const other = b[i]!;
			return (
				file.id === other.id &&
				file.name === other.name &&
				file.url === other.url &&
				file.mimeType === other.mimeType &&
				file.size === other.size
			);
		})
	);
}
/** 比较实际持久化值；数组快照换引用不代表编辑，顺序和资源元数据变化仍需判脏。 */
export const richEquals = Object.freeze({
	region: Object.is,
	startDate: Object.is,
	dueDate: Object.is,
	budget: Object.is,
	progress: Object.is,
	enabled: Object.is,
	tags: equalTags,
	time: Object.is,
	attachments: equalAttachments
});

		multiple
		:upload="upload"

		@update:model-value="update"

<script setup lang="ts">
import { AsamUpload } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamUploadedResource, AsamUploadHandler, AsamUploadValue } from '@asam-ui/ui';
defineProps<{ modelValue: readonly AsamUploadedResource[]; disabled?: boolean }>();
const emit = defineEmits<{ 'update:modelValue': [value: AsamUploadedResource[]] }>();
const upload: AsamUploadHandler = async ({ file }, context) => {
	context.reportProgress({ loaded: file.size / 2, total: file.size });
	await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 80));
	if (context.signal.aborted) throw new DOMException('Aborted', 'AbortError');
	context.reportProgress({ loaded: file.size, total: file.size });
	return {
		id: 'demo-' + file.name + '-' + file.size,
		name: file.name,
		url: '/__local-preview__/' + encodeURIComponent(file.name),
		size: file.size,
		mimeType: file.type || 'application/octet-stream'
	};
};
function update(value: AsamUploadValue) {
	if (Array.isArray(value)) emit('update:modelValue', [...value]);
}
</script>

/** 仅视觉演示内存服务；控制器、校验和写入入口仍消费正常公共包。 */
export function createProjectMock(empty = false) {
	const rows = new Map();
	if (!empty)
		for (let index = 0; index < 24; index++) {
			const id = index + 1;
			rows.set(id, {
				...defaults(),
				id,
				version: 1,
				name: names[index % names.length] + (index >= names.length ? ' · 二期' : ''),
				reference: `PRJ-2026-${String(id).padStart(3, '0')}`,
				owner: owners[index % owners.length],
				status: statuses[[0, 1, 0, 2, 3, 0][index % 6]],
				startDate: '2026-10-01',
				dueDate: `2026-11-${String(5 + index).padStart(2, '0')}`,
				priority: index % 3 ? '中' : '高',
				budget: 48000 + index * 3200,
				progress: [68, 0, 42, 100, 35, 76][index % 6],
				tags: ['重点项目', '跨团队'],
				attachments: [
					{
						id: `project-spec-${id}`,
						name: '项目交付清单与里程碑计划.pdf',
						url: `/__mock-project-documents__/${id}`,
						mimeType: 'application/pdf',
						size: 1887437
					}
				],
				note: '统一项目计划、交付资料与跨团队协作。当前里程碑为完成核心流程联调，下一阶段进入使用反馈与体验优化。'
			});

	const applied = new Set();

		async list(request) {
			const filtered = [...rows.values()].filter((row) =>
				Object.entries(request.query).every(
					([key, value]) =>
						!value || String(Reflect.get(row, key) ?? '').includes(String(value))
				)
			);
			return {
				list: filtered
					.slice(
						(request.currentPage - 1) * request.pageSize,
						request.currentPage * request.pageSize
					)
					.map((row) => ({ ...copy(row), id: row.id, version: row.version })),
				total: filtered.length
			};
		},
		async defaults() {
			return defaults();
		},
		async load(key) {
			const row = rows.get(key);
			if (!row) throw new Error('项目已不存在');
			return copy(row);
		},
		async create(model, operation) {
			const id = ++sequence;
			rows.set(id, {
				...copy(model),
				id,
				version: 1,
				reference: `PRJ-2026-${String(id).padStart(3, '0')}`
			});
			applied.add(operation.target.operationId);
			return { status: 'success' };
		},
		async update(key, model, operation) {
			const row = rows.get(key);
			if (!row) return { status: 'failure', message: '项目已不存在' };
			rows.set(key, { ...copy(model), id: key, version: row.version + 1 });
			applied.add(operation.target.operationId);
			return { status: 'success' };
		},
		async verify(operation) {
			return {
				status: applied.has(operation.target.operationId) ? 'success' : 'not-applied'
			};
		},
		async resolve(keys) {
			return keys.map((key) => {
				const row = rows.get(key);
				return row
					? {
							key,
							target: {
								key,
								version: String(row.version),
								payload: { name: row.name }
							}
						}
					: { key, reason: '项目已不存在' };
			});
		},
		async remove(target) {
			rows.delete(target.key);
			return { key: target.key, status: 'success' };
		},
		async verifyRemove(target) {
			return { key: target.key, status: rows.has(target.key) ? 'unsent' : 'success' };
		}
	};
	return {
		services,
		async detail(key) {
			const row = rows.get(key);
			return row ? { status: 'ready', data: { ...copy(row) } } : { status: 'missing' };
		},
		complete(keys) {
			for (const key of keys) {
				const row = rows.get(key);
				if (row) rows.set(key, { ...row, status: '已完成', progress: 100 });
			}
		}
	};
}

import {

const baseCodec = {

			const value = model[key];

			return value;
		};
		return {
			name: text('name'),
			team: text('team'),
			status: text('status'),
			owner: text('owner'),
			email: text('email'),
			note: text('note')

};
const defaults = () => ({

	category: '组件演示',

	startDate: '',

	enabled: false,

	attachments: []

const string = (v) => typeof v === 'string';
const strings = (v) => Array.isArray(v) && v.every(string);
const finite = (v) => typeof v === 'number' && Number.isFinite(v);
function resources(v) {
	return (
		Array.isArray(v) &&
		v.every(
			(r) =>
				!!r &&
				typeof r === 'object' &&
				typeof Reflect.get(r, 'id') === 'string' &&
				typeof Reflect.get(r, 'name') === 'string' &&
				typeof Reflect.get(r, 'url') === 'string' &&
				typeof Reflect.get(r, 'mimeType') === 'string' &&
				finite(Reflect.get(r, 'size')) &&
				Reflect.get(r, 'size') >= 0

}

	const result = defaults();
	for (const key of ['reference', 'category', 'priority']) {
		const value = Reflect.get(model, key);
		if (value !== undefined) {
			if (!string(value)) throw new TypeError(key);
			result[key] = value;
		}
	}
	for (const key of ['region', 'startDate', 'dueDate', 'time']) {
		const value = Reflect.get(model, key);
		if (value !== undefined) {
			if (value !== null && !string(value)) throw new TypeError(key);
			result[key] = value;
		}
	}
	for (const key of ['budget', 'progress']) {
		const value = Reflect.get(model, key);
		if (value !== undefined) {
			if (!finite(value)) throw new TypeError(key);
			result[key] = value;
		}
	}
	for (const key of ['channels', 'tags']) {
		const value = Reflect.get(model, key);
		if (value !== undefined) {
			if (!strings(value)) throw new TypeError(key);

		if (typeof enabled !== 'boolean') throw new TypeError('enabled');

}
export const richCodec = {
	encode: (model) => ({

		channels: [...model.channels],
		tags: [...model.tags],

	defineAsamOptions().static({ options: values.map((value) => ({ value, label: value })) });
function custom(key, label, component, valid, empty, group, componentProps = {}, span) {
	return {

		control: defineAsamControl({

const editableFields = [
	{
