		kind: 'textarea',
		label: '备注',
		modes: { edit: { layout: { group: '附件与备注', span: 2 } } }
	}
];
export const richFields = editableFields.map((field) => ({
	...field,
	modes: { ...field.modes, detail: { layout: field.modes?.edit?.layout } }
}));
function equalTags(a, b) {
	return strings(a) && strings(b) && a.length === b.length && a.every((tag, i) => tag === b[i]);
}
function equalAttachments(a, b) {
	return (
		resources(a) &&
		resources(b) &&
		a.length === b.length &&
		a.every((file, i) => {
			const other = b[i];
			return (
				file.id === other.id &&
				file.name === other.name &&
				file.url === other.url &&
				file.mimeType === other.mimeType &&
				file.size === other.size
			);
		})
	);
}
/** 比较实际持久化值；数组快照换引用不代表编辑，顺序和资源元数据变化仍需判脏。 */
export const richEquals = Object.freeze({
	region: Object.is,
	startDate: Object.is,
	dueDate: Object.is,
	budget: Object.is,
	progress: Object.is,
	enabled: Object.is,
	tags: equalTags,
	time: Object.is,
	attachments: equalAttachments
});
vue
<template>
	<AsamUpload
		:model-value="modelValue"
		multiple
		:upload="upload"
		:disabled="disabled"
		drag
		@update:model-value="update"
	>
		<p>选择或拖入演示附件</p>
		<template #tip>本地合成上传，不连接真实服务。</template>
	</AsamUpload>
</template>
<script setup>
import { AsamUpload } from '@asam-ui/ui';
defineProps({
	modelValue: { type: Array, required: true },
	disabled: { type: Boolean, required: false }
});
const emit = defineEmits(['update:modelValue']);
const upload = async ({ file }, context) => {
	context.reportProgress({ loaded: file.size / 2, total: file.size });
	await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 80));
	if (context.signal.aborted) throw new DOMException('Aborted', 'AbortError');
	context.reportProgress({ loaded: file.size, total: file.size });
	return {
		id: 'demo-' + file.name + '-' + file.size,
		name: file.name,
		url: '/__local-preview__/' + encodeURIComponent(file.name),
		size: file.size,
		mimeType: file.type || 'application/octet-stream'
	};
};
function update(value) {
	if (Array.isArray(value)) emit('update:modelValue', [...value]);
}
</script>

Shared search, forms, and details ​

Reuse the standalone CRUD subcomponents with the existing controllers when you need to control their layout. Open the composition example.

Open the standalone CRUD demo (Chinese)

Data and write behavior ​

  • The list controller owns the current query, sort order, page, and returned rows. A borrowed list controller stays under application ownership. The application also owns the runtime and write coordinators.
  • Define Row, Query, Edit and Key to match your service. Use queryCodec and editCodec to validate and convert field models at the boundary. A finite number and its string representation are distinct keys.
  • Keep the operation ID if a write has an unknown outcome. Verify the original operation. Retry only after the service confirms it was not applied. A failure reported by the service must establish that the write did not apply.
  • Bulk removal resolves and confirms specific targets, checks permission and version before each send, and records each result. Retry eligible targets from the original operation record. Successfully removed targets are skipped.
  • A late write result remains with its original query scope. Refresh runs once for applicable successful results. Refresh failures can be retried separately.
  • readonly permits queries, pagination, details, and verification. disabled blocks new interaction through the page.

Two-way bindings ​

Binding Values Update event
v-model:contentWidth 'contained', 'full', or undefined update:contentWidth
v-model:border boolean or undefined update:border

Component API ​

The generated tables show the live prop and slot types, including defaults and generic parameters. Read the full API.

Props ​

Supply controller and set title where needed. Use viewMode, presentation, and sectionCards for the page layout. The query form uses queryColumns, queryCollapsedCount, and queryFieldLabels. Table controls include pagination, tableSize, stripe, border, rowActions and the action-column settings. Editor and detail display have separate settings.

Events ​

refresh-state reports refresh progress. expand-change reports table expansion changes. The width and border bindings emit their corresponding update events.

Slots ​

Use navigation, heading, toolbar, cell, and record to customize individual areas. The page also exposes query, content, editor, detail, detail-content, and the default slot.

Exposed instance ​

The public instance exposes controller and focus.

Related components ​

  • Search form
  • CRUD table and pagination
  • Editor form
  • Edit dialog and edit drawer
  • Detail panel, detail dialog, and detail drawer

import type { AsamCrudPageProps, AsamCrudKey, AsamCrudViewController, AsamCrudController, AsamListAction } from '@asam-ui/pro';

type PublicMember<T, K extends PropertyKey> = T extends unknown ? K extends keyof T ? T[K] : never : never;

// AsamCrudPageProps
type PublicContract<Row extends object, Key extends AsamCrudKey, Controller extends AsamCrudViewController<Row, Key> = AsamCrudController<Row, Key>> = {
	readonly "controller": Controller & AsamCrudViewController<Row, Key>;
	readonly "title"?: string | undefined;
	readonly "description"?: string | undefined;
	readonly "createLabel"?: string | undefined;
	readonly "editLabel"?: string | undefined;
	readonly "detailLabel"?: string | undefined;
	readonly "size"?: (AsamCrudPageProps<Row, Key, Controller>)["size"];
	readonly "tableSize"?: (AsamCrudPageProps<Row, Key, Controller>)["tableSize"];
	readonly "viewMode"?: "standard" | "legacy" | undefined;
	readonly "presentation"?: "full" | "query-table" | undefined;
	readonly "detailDisplay"?: "dialog" | "drawer" | undefined;
	readonly "sectionCards"?: boolean | undefined;
